svg.title: Enneper minimal surface
svg.desc: An orthographic wireframe of X(u,v)=(u−u³/3+uv², v−v³/3+u²v, u²−v²), on the square −1.3≤u,v≤1.3. Mean curvature is zero. The gold curve is the image of u²+v²=0.94². This is an immersion, not a claim of global embeddedness.
svg.title: Enneper minimal surface
